newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian scientist sentenced to 12 years for spying.
newsitem.headline: Russian scientist sentenced to 12 years for spying.

text.p: A Russian scientist was sentenced on Friday to 12 years hard labour for spying for the United States, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Moisei Finkel, 60, arrested in 1994, had pleaded not guilty at a trial in Moscow's top security Lefortovo prison, Tass said.
Finkel had worked at a defence research institute and had access to classified materials on the latest acoustic systems, Tass said. Such systems are used in nuclear submarines.
Finkel contacted U.S. officials in 1993 seeking political asylum and agreed to pass on information, Tass said.
Some Western officials have expressed alarm at huge sums Moscow is pouring into new attack submarines which are intended to play a much more aggressive role than in the past.
Experts say the Russians have been developing submarines designed to roam the oceans in the hunt for other vessels.
